name: analytics
description: The Web Analytics workspace: properties, daily metrics, pages, sources, events and conversions, kept as JSON in the app's data home; the tracking endpoint writes page views through the same service.
mount: a row `- id: analytics` / `name: analytics` before the report rows in blend.yaml; a page injects the `analytics` service

config.file: the JSON file, relative to the app's home (default web-analytics.json)
config.clock: what time it is, for tests
config.newId: how ids are made, for tests
